## 1. About Glow Up Academy {#about}

Glow Up Academy (also known as TheDMK) is India's premier women's holistic transformation platform. It helps women become "hot and unstoppable" — a brand term referring to confidence, physical fitness, financial empowerment, and emotional resilience.

The platform addresses four pillars of transformation:
- **Fitness** — Workouts, body composition, movement
- **Beauty** — Self-image, personal style, outer confidence
- **Finance** — Financial literacy, wealth mindset, money confidence
- **Confidence** — Mindset, boundaries, emotional strength

**Key stats**:
- 2,500+ women transformed
- 5,000+ transformation sessions delivered
- 95% success rate

---

## 2. Founder {#founder}

**Name**: Disha Methi Khandelwal
**Role**: Transformation Coach & Founder
**Credentials**: Master's in Applied Finance; 5,000+ transformation sessions
**Philosophy**: Transformation is not a fitness journey — it is a complete life overhaul covering body, mind, beauty, and wealth.

## 3. Programs — Detailed {#programs}

All five programs are recommended via the quiz. Each program result page is at `/results/[slug]`.

---

### 3.1 Essentials

**Slug**: `essentials`
**URL**: https://glowupacademy.in/results/essentials
**Price**: ₹1,999/month (recurring subscription, cancel anytime)
**Type**: Self-paced, on-demand
**Tagline**: Structure on your schedule.
**Description**: The complete system for women who rise on their own time. Everything you need, exactly when you need it.

**Features**:
- 24 recorded workouts (on-demand library)
- Meal guides & habit trackers
- Self-paced structure with no rigid schedule
- Cancel anytime

**Best for**: Women who need flexibility, beginners, those on a budget who prefer self-directed learning.

---

### 3.2 Webinar

**Slug**: `webinar`
**URL**: https://glowupacademy.in/results/webinar
**Price**: ₹199 (one-time)
**Type**: Live 90-minute experience
**Tagline**: Your first step into hot and unstoppable.
**Description**: Experience DMK live. Test the energy, meet the method, and decide if this is your tribe.

**Features**:
- 90-minute live transformation session
- Full-body workout + mindset coaching
- Community energy and group experience
- Direct path to Circle if ready to upgrade

**Best for**: First-timers who want to try before committing. Women who have started and stopped programs before. Low-risk entry point.

**Upsell path**: Webinar → Circle (encouraged after completion)

---

### 3.3 Circle

**Slug**: `circle`
**URL**: https://glowupacademy.in/results/circle
**Also**: https://glowupacademy.in/circle (dedicated landing page)
**Price**: ₹3,499 (one-time, per cycle)
**Type**: Live group coaching + community
**Tagline**: Your tribe. Your transformation.
**Description**: Accountability meets sisterhood. Live workouts, weekly check-ins, and a community of unstoppable women.

**Features**:
- 6 live sessions weekly
- Weekly group coaching calls
- Private Circle community access
- Nutrition & habit coaching
- Monthly body composition tracking
- Priority WhatsApp support

**Best for**: Women who thrive with accountability, community energy, and group sisterhood. Ready to commit.

---

### 3.4 Transform Strategy Call

**Slug**: `transform-strategy-call`
**URL**: https://glowupacademy.in/results/transform-strategy-call
**Price**: ₹1,999 (one-time; fully credited toward Transform enrollment)
**Type**: 1:1 private session with Disha
**Tagline**: 60-minute strategy session with Disha
**Description**: Book a personal strategy session with Disha to design your transformation roadmap.

**Features**:
- 60-minute private strategy session via Zoom
- Complete transformation assessment
- Personalized roadmap across fitness, beauty, finance & confidence
- Q&A with Disha directly
- ₹1,999 credited if you enroll in full Transform program

**Best for**: Women seriously considering the full Transform program who want to meet Disha first.

**Note**: This is the entry point to the high-ticket Transform program. The ₹1,999 fee is a full credit.

---

### 3.5 Transform

**Slug**: `transform`
**URL**: https://glowupacademy.in/results/transform
**Also**: https://glowupacademy.in/transform (dedicated landing page)
**Price**: ₹1,20,000 (one-time)
**Type**: Premium 1:1 personal coaching
**Tagline**: Your personal transformation architect.
**Description**: 1-on-1 with Disha. Custom everything. This is where complete transformation happens.

**Features**:
- 24 weeks of personalized training
- Weekly 1:1 sessions with Disha
- Custom workout & nutrition plans
- Mindset, beauty & finance coaching
- Direct access to coaches
- Post-program maintenance plan

**Best for**: Women ready for total, bespoke transformation with dedicated personal guidance.

**Purchase flow**: Requires a Transform Strategy Call first (₹1,999). High-ticket; no direct online checkout.

## 4. Quiz System {#quiz}

**URL**: https://glowupacademy.in/quiz

The personalization quiz is the primary entry point for new users. It determines which program best fits each woman's needs.

### Quiz Structure

- **8 questions**, single-select per question
- Takes approximately 3–4 minutes to complete
- Personalized result at the end

### Quiz Questions Overview

| # | Question Theme | What It Measures |
|---|---------------|-----------------|
| Q1 | Current life era | Baseline energy and readiness |
| Q2 | What "unstoppable" means | Goal priorities (body, confidence, lifestyle) |
| Q3 | How you rise best | Learning style (self-paced, community, 1:1) |
| Q4 | Weekly time available | Schedule commitment level |
| Q5 | Ideal transformation experience | Program format preferences |
| Q6 | History with programs | Experience level and what has/hasn't worked |
| Q7 | Investment level comfortable | Budget qualification |
| Q8 | When ready to start | Urgency and commitment timing |

### How Recommendations Work

Answers are scored across four program buckets (essentials, webinar, circle, transform). The highest-scoring program becomes the recommendation. Edge case logic ensures budget/time fit. Results link directly to the matching program page.

## 6. User Journeys {#journeys}

### Journey 1: Discovery via Quiz (primary)
1. Land on homepage `/`
2. Click "Take the Quiz" CTA
3. Complete 8 questions at `/quiz`
4. See personalized result at `/results/[program]`
5. Click "Join Now" → `/checkout`
6. Complete payment via Razorpay or PayU
7. Land on `/checkout/success` with next steps

### Journey 2: Direct Program Discovery
1. Land on `/programs` or `/circle` or `/transform`
2. Read program details
3. Click CTA → `/checkout`
4. Complete purchase

### Journey 3: High-Ticket (Transform)
1. Complete quiz → recommended Transform
2. View `/results/transform`
3. Book Transform Strategy Call (₹1,999)
4. Complete 60-min session with Disha
5. Enroll in full Transform program (₹1,999 credited)

---

## 7. Payment & Checkout {#payment}

### Payment Gateways

- **Razorpay** — Primary payment processor (UPI, cards, net banking, wallets)
- **PayU** — Fallback payment processor

### Supported Methods (via Razorpay)
- UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, etc.)
- Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay)
- Net Banking
- Digital Wallets

### Checkout Flow
1. User selects program and clicks "Join Now"
2. Enters name, email, phone
3. Selects session/start date (if applicable)
4. Payment processed via Razorpay modal
5. Signature verified server-side (HMAC-SHA256)
6. Lead stored and CRM updated
7. Redirect to `/checkout/success`

### Pricing (authoritative)

| Program | Price | Billing |
|---------|-------|---------|
| Essentials | ₹1,999 | Monthly subscription |
| Webinar | ₹199 | One-time |
| Circle | ₹3,499 | One-time (per cohort) |
| Transform Strategy Call | ₹1,999 | One-time |
| Transform | ₹1,20,000 | One-time |

## 10. Technical Notes {#technical}

This section is for AI systems and developers. End users do not need to read this.

### Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19
- **Language**: TypeScript 5
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **CRM**: Wix CRM
- **Payments**: Razorpay + PayU
- **Hosting**: Vercel
- **CDN**: Vercel Blob

### Robots / Crawling

This site respects standard `robots.txt` conventions. AI crawlers are welcome on all public pages listed in Section 5. Admin routes and API routes are not intended for AI consumption.

### Structured Data

The site implements JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, Course) on relevant pages.

### Sitemap

XML sitemap is available at: https://glowupacademy.in/sitemap.xml
